recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It fixes a clear semantic inversion in active core Resource guidance; any broader removal or redesign requested by unresolved FHIR-53182 should be handled separately after work-group decision.
issue_request: FHIR-20632 was Published with resolution Not Persuasive with Modification. The original request asked to remove the old statement that security labels are unique by system+code; the final resolution instead required making explicit that two security labels with the same system+code but different .display or .version are invalid and that display/version are ignored when evaluating labels.
initial_application: The Jira-tagged commit 7a0ddbd3129ca96c60aa283cac8b67bdfb21c9b1 replaced the old set sentence in source/resource/resource-notes.xml for R5, but introduced the opposite wording by saying such duplicate security labels were valid.
additional_context: source/resource/resource-notes.xml feeds the active Resource page, and source/fhir.ini lists Resource as an active normative artifact. The parallel Meta.security definition in source/datatypes/meta.xml says security labels are a set with uniqueness based on system/code while version and display are ignored. FHIR-53182 later questions the note but is Triaged/unresolved, so it is not a final superseding decision. Zulip/Confluence searches found no final community record overriding FHIR-20632.
reconciliation: Changed the Resource security-label note from 'it is valid' to 'it is not valid' and changed the follow-up sentence to say .display and .version are not taken into account, aligning the source with the published resolution and Meta.security definition.
source_changes: source/resource/resource-notes.xml: corrected the security-label duplicate guidance from valid to not valid and clarified that both .display and .version are ignored when evaluating labels.

related_jiras.note: Later R6 issue questions whether the security-label note should remain, but it is Triaged/unresolved and does not supersede the Published FHIR-20632 decision.
